title: AG60003: Farm Machinery Design And Testing
text:
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Basic design principles of farm machines, implements and tools. Design and
selection of power transmission elements. Design of primary and secondary
tillage implements. Design of seeders, planters, transplanting machines,
fertilizer distributors and plant protection equipments. Design of harvesting
and threshing machines for cereals, pulses and root crops. Design of farm
transport equipment. Test codes. Performance indices. Selection of machine for
various farming operations.
